name: market-outlook-automation
description: Regenerates the MarketOutlook report from VS Code using Copilot-authenticated language models.

marketOutlook.reportPath.description: Path to the report HTML file, relative to the workspace folder unless absolute.

marketOutlook.autoRunOnStartup.description: Automatically refresh the market outlook when VS Code starts and this workspace is open.

marketOutlook.exitAfterAutomation.description: Quit VS Code after an automated refresh finishes. Intended for scheduled runs.
